config.description: Movements taught with neural_reflex.movements and the robot motor each one drives. While a movement is recognised continuously for hold_s, its motor moves in `direction` (+1 = larger ticks) at speed_ticks_s; when you stop, the motor holds where it is. Remove a movement from this list to leave it out of teaching and control. For shoulder_lift, larger ticks tilt the arm forward/down from straight up.

movements.name: wrist_up
movements.instruction: Keep the forearm still, BEND your WRIST UP (back of hand up) and hold

movements.name: wrist_down
movements.instruction: Keep the forearm still, BEND your WRIST DOWN and hold

movements.name: index_pinch
movements.instruction: PINCH thumb and INDEX finger together firmly and hold

movements.name: middle_pinch
movements.instruction: PINCH thumb and MIDDLE finger together firmly and hold

movements.name: fist
movements.instruction: Make a FIRM FIST and hold

movements.name: spread
movements.instruction: SPREAD your fingers wide and hold
